query: NVIDIA and AMD fiscal quarter end dates comparison
normalized: amd comparison dates end fiscal nvidia quarter

output.content:
**NVIDIA’s fiscal calendar runs about one month later than AMD’s for the same underlying calendar quarter.** NVIDIA’s FY2026 Q4 ended January 25, 2026, while AMD’s FY2025 ended December 27, 2025; in other words, NVIDIA assigns the December-ending quarter to the following fiscal year. [[1]] [[2]]

| Same calendar-period quarter | NVIDIA fiscal label and quarter end | AMD fiscal label and quarter end | Difference |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Mar./Apr. 2025 | Q1 FY2026 — Apr. 27, 2025 | Q1 FY2025 — Mar. 29, 2025 | NVIDIA ends 29 days later. [[3]] [[2]]|
| Jun./Jul. 2025 | Q2 FY2026 — Jul. 27, 2025 | Q2 FY2025 — Jun. 28, 2025 | NVIDIA ends 29 days later. [[4]] [[2]]|
| Sep./Oct. 2025 | Q3 FY2026 — Oct. 26, 2025 | Q3 FY2025 — Sep. 27, 2025 | NVIDIA ends 29 days later. [[1]] [[2]]|
| Dec. 2025/Jan. 2026 | Q4 FY2026 — Jan. 25, 2026 | Q4 FY2025 — Dec. 27, 2025 | NVIDIA ends 29 days later. [[1]] [[2]]|

AMD explicitly uses a 52- or 53-week fiscal year ending on the last Saturday in December. [[5]] NVIDIA’s reported quarter ends in this comparison fall on Sundays—April 27, July 27, October 26, and January 25—so its fiscal reporting period is effectively shifted roughly four weeks later than AMD’s. [[3]] [[4]] [[1]]

**Practical comparison rule:** compare NVIDIA **FY2026** quarters with AMD **FY2025** quarters, rather than matching fiscal-year labels; this aligns the companies’ underlying calendar periods most closely. [[1]] [[2]]
